content.text: ▪︎results when a fixed coronary plaque prevents
sufficient blood supply thru a coronary a.
@ times of ⇡ O2 demand, resulting in
chest discomfort during times of physical or
: unable to perform any activity w/o SXS
lasts <15 min (>30 min → think other dx)
▪︎frequent presentation: L-sided exertional CP radiating down L arm; also epigastric region, wrists, fingers
▪︎TC, LDL, HDL, TGs, glucose (A1C), BUN/Cr, Hct
: resting EKG norm in up to 50% of pts
▪︎⍉exercise stress test if: unstable angina, symptomatic AS
for concurrent HTN, DM, LVEF ≤40%, or CKD
high-intensity statin for all pts ≥20yo w/ ASCVD
» Second line agents: nitrates, CCBs, ranolazine
➁ CCBs: used if intolerant to BBs
➂ Ranolazine: alt to BBs, refractory
» combo TX: BB + CCB, BB + ISDN, CCB + ISDN
▪︎Lt main stenosis >50% or equivalent (prox LAD & LCx >70%)
▪︎triple-vessel dz, particularly w/ EF <50% or previous transmural MI (CABG also favored w/ EF ≤35%)
▪︎2-vessel dz w/ DM; UA refractory to pharm; ongoing angina or severe ischemia on noninvasive testing w/ previous MI
